title: I Will Not Let You Go

request.style: English, slow Delta blues, gravelly weathered male vocal, slide guitar, harmonica, upright bass, brushed snare, stomping and raw, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I sent my wives and children across the Jabbok ford
I sent the gift on ahead of me, every flock and herd
Then I was left alone there on the river bank that night
A man came out of the darkness and he wrestled me till light

[Chorus]
I will not let you go unless you bless me
Wrestled all night long until the day was breaking
He touched my hip and wrenched it but I'm holding on
I will not let you go unless you bless me

[Verse]
He asked me what's your name, I said Jacob is my name
The heel-grabber, the schemer, the man who carried shame
Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel
You have struggled with God and with men and have prevailed

[Chorus]
I will not let you go unless you bless me
Wrestled all night long until the day was breaking
He touched my hip and wrenched it but I'm holding on
I will not let you go unless you bless me

[Bridge]
I named that place Peniel
I have seen God face to face
And yet my life was spared
The sun rose above him as he passed Penuel
And he was limping because of his hip

[Outro]
Limping in the sunrise
Blessed and holding on
I will not let you go
